works.title: Eximius Story and Sermon
works.description: A personal essay/sermon about the user's graduating class (Eximius) from Nigeria ten years ago, centered on a classmate's gesture of organizing a giveaway for the group. The piece develops themes of faithfulness, economic disparity, and community care within a religious/spiritual framework.
works.quote: Can you help me rewrite the story better?

works.title: Trump Fail Weak Loser
works.description: A data-driven political critique article analyzing Trump's first year of his second term (January 2025 – January 2026). The piece presents a factual indictment of policy failures, using forensic analysis and documented evidence to argue Trump has weakened American power and betrayed allies.
works.quote: This is not fiction. It's based on historical facts up through January 9, 2026, eleven months into his term.

works.title: Romantic-Comedy Story (Gates Decision Architecture)
works.description: A romantic-comedy novel-in-planning about a character who has developed and now applies a multi-stage selection criteria (gates) system for choosing a significant other. The narrative structure uses flashbacks to explain why each gate exists, with three contrasting case-study women to test the algorithm.
works.quote: At some point I'm going to write a story with a character who goes through the same refinement process I did to develop my selection criteria for choosing a significant other.
